claims: BYD stands for Build Your Dreams.
Most BYD vehicles utilize the BYD Blade Battery (LFP).
The BYD Blade Battery passes nail penetration tests.
The BYD Seal can accelerate from 0-100 km/h in 3.8 seconds.
The BYD Atto 3 is also known as Yuan Plus.
The BYD Atto 3 is a compact crossover SUV.
The BYD Atto 3 has a 5-star Euro NCAP safety rating.
The BYD Seal is a sedan.
The BYD Dolphin is a compact city hatchback.
The BYD Tang is a 7-seater all-wheel-drive SUV.
The BYD Denza Z9 GT has up to 800 km WLTP range.
Many BYD models can charge from 10% to 80% in approximately 30-33 minutes.
The Sealion 6 DM-i is a BYD plug-in hybrid.
